The '''Black Sun ruling council''' was the ruling council of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] stationed at a [[Black Sun fortress/Legends|facility]] on the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] world of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], all the council members were [[Mission to Mustafar (Death Watch)/Legends|eliminated]] after they refused to join the new [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] being formed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] allies. Each member was beheaded with the [[Sai cha/Legends|Sai Cha]] technique when [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] [[Telekinesis/Legends|threw]] his [[Savage Opress's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] across the table.
